It didn’t feel like mania, but looking back, it was definitely more than just feeling good. Then it crashed. That’s when the depression deepened. I’ve had at least one of those high phases before, same pattern. My boss even commented on how “wired” I seemed. So no, it’s not *just* depression—it's this cycle. I’ve had real hypomanic episodes. That’s what keeps me up at night—the switch, the pattern.
